svg.aria-label: AI security. Controls for AI agents: tool-call authorization, runtime governance, agent identity, audit trails that hold up. AI governance. ISO/IEC 42001, the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF and India's DPDP Act, turned into controls a team can actually operate. Post-quantum readiness. Cryptographic inventory, crypto-agility and migration governance, framed as a risk programme rather than an algorithm swap. GRC engineering. Continuous evidence instead of annual audits, controls as code, multi-framework crosswalks using NIST IR 8477 set-theory mapping.
